news.analysis: Brissett threw the ball nearly 50 times in his first game with the Ravens. He was able to rack up 340 yards in the process, but he didn't score any touchdowns, which left him with an underwhelming fantasy score individually. He was able to successfully support Zay Flowers and Mark Andrews, but the team will almost certainly want him to throw significantly less passes on a game-to-game basis moving forward, so those guys may not have the consistent workload that this week suggested they might.
news.contents: Jacoby Brissett completed 33-of-49 passing attempts for 340 yards and one interception in Monday night's 23-20 loss to the Los Angeles Chargers.

news.analysis: Nacua has received a three-game suspension after an NFL review determined that he violated their Personal Conduct Policy. However, he is currently on injured reserve and is several weeks away from being eligible to return, so that suspension will be served while he's on IR, meaning that this suspension won't cause him to miss any more time than he was already set to miss due to injury. Fantasy managers should continue to keep close tabs on updates about his health over the next few weeks, as he could be a very valuable asset if he's cleared to play in time for the fantasy playoffs.

news.contents: The NFL has told Los Angeles Rams wide receiver Puka Nacua (knee, toe) that any further violation of the league's personal conduct policy will subject him to further discipline as severe as a potential banishment, per Jonathan Jones of The Athletic.
